name: NAURA Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: NAURA Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and technical services of semiconductors in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Semiconductor Equipment, Vacuum New Energy Equipment, and Precision Component segments. The company offers semiconductor process equipment including etching, thin film deposition, thermal processing, wet cleaning, ion implantation, coating and developing, and bonding which are used in the manufacturing of integrated circuits, power semiconductors, 3D integration and advanced packaging, compound semiconductors, and new displays.
